channel.title: AI GridWatch — Maryland data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Maryland, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Garrett County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Data center moratorium; western Maryland county

item.title: Ridgely: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium; part of an Eastern Shore wave of local action after a controversial Federalsburg data center proposal

item.title: Harford County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban — first MD county to permanently ban data centers, unanimous. A single hyperscale facility could double the county's residential electricity demand. Legal challenges anticipated

item.title: Howard County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 17-month moratorium (S.M.A.R.T. Act), unanimous. Expires Nov 2 2027 or when zoning amendment passes. Task force of up to 11 appointees studying impacts. Existing zoning dates to 1993

item.title: Carroll County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium to study economic and environmental impacts and propose regulations

item.title: Queen Anne's County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, effective immediately. Part of the Eastern Shore moratorium wave after the Federalsburg data center proposal

item.title: Caroline County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium in unincorporated areas. Part of the Eastern Shore moratorium wave

item.title: Dorchester County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium. Part of the Eastern Shore moratorium cluster

item.title: Talbot County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 1-year moratorium resolution introduced; public comment hearing scheduled Sep 8. Not yet enacted

item.title: Baltimore City: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: CB 26-0158: 1 year, facilities drawing 10 MW or more; 9-month impact study

item.title: Prince George's County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year pause on hyperscale data centers — the longest in Maryland. Bars the planning department from considering applications until the council passes regulations. Three members abstained; one voted no

item.title: Baltimore County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year, passed unanimously; runs no later than Jan 1, 2027. A 6-month extension was being introduced in Aug 2026 with a bipartisan majority and the county executive behind it

item.title: Montgomery County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium approved unanimously, alongside limits on data center development
